ambiguity: GLOSS.sphere ambiguity 3: 'A Sphere's point of origin is included': is a creature whose space holds the origin (including the caster) in the area?
ruling: Reading A: a creature whose space holds the point of origin is in the Sphere and is affected like any other creature in it, including a caster who places the Sphere on their own space. This is the opposite of P-25/P-27 for Cones and Cubes. A caster away from the origin isn't in the Sphere: it isn't an Emanation.
